claims.assertion: Athena describes hyperspace as a frequency-state change: ship structure remains intact while its compatibility shifts from origin to destination.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
claims.qualifiers: She says this is not propulsion through distance.

claims.assertion: Athena says high-mass ships cannot shift frequency instantly; limited engine power relative to mass requires gradual jumps and creates perceived SIT delay.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
claims.qualifiers: Delay varies with each ship’s power-to-mass ratio.

claims.assertion: Athena estimates Earth–Temmer travel at seven hours of SIT aboard Toleka versus 36 minutes aboard Suzy.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
claims.qualifiers: The better power-to-mass ship makes larger frequency jumps.
